svg.title: Where Sumatran rhinos live
svg.desc: A simplified map of Sumatra in Indonesia. Sumatran rhinos are known from three separated forests: Gunung Leuser in the north, Bukit Barisan Selatan in the south west and Way Kambas in the south east, where the breeding sanctuary holds ten animals. Two or three rhinos may also survive in Borneo. Between 34 and 47 are believed to remain worldwide, down from an estimate of 180 to 200 in 2007.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three separated forests on one island, and nobody can see the animals in them.
